Privacy Policy

Last updated: July 24, 2026

This Privacy Policy explains how Tap Tap Sorry ("we", "our", or "the app") collects, uses, and protects your information. By using the app, you agree to the practices described in this policy.

Information We Collect

Tap Tap Sorry is designed to be a simple, offline stress-relief game. We do not collect, store, or transmit any personal information to our servers. The app operates entirely on your device.

Specifically, the app may access:

  • Photo Library — Only if you choose to import a custom photo as a character image. This photo is stored locally on your device and is never uploaded anywhere.
  • Audio Files — Only if you choose to import a custom audio file for voice playback. This file is stored locally on your device and is never uploaded anywhere.

How We Use Your Information

We do not use, share, or process any personal information because we do not collect any. All data you create (custom characters, voice selections) stays on your device and is only used locally by the app.

Data Storage

All app data is stored locally on your device using iOS standard storage mechanisms. No data is transmitted to any external server or third party.

Third-Party Services

Tap Tap Sorry does not integrate any third-party analytics, advertising, or tracking services. The app does not contain any SDKs that collect user data.

Children's Privacy

The app is not directed at children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect any personal information from children.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated "Last updated" date.
